title: Volume 5 Form B — Change the allocation mechanism
review_type: Specialist author prompt, solution, arithmetic, proof-scope, instructional and scoring review; root independently audits and alone integrates/accepts the complete volume package

administration.resources: Closed notes and solutions; basic nonprogrammable calculator; exact fractions, radicals and logarithmic expressions accepted. No computer execution or external lookup.
administration.workload: Five bounded four-part domain tasks; approximately34minutes per domain plus10minutes for checking. All necessary economic inputs, finite action domains, wage classes, preferences, observed outcomes and randomization counts are supplied. No logarithm evaluation or advanced theorem proof is required.
administration.scoring: All20parts have an explicit five-point allocation in the solutions. Valid equivalent derivations and permitted alternative public-good fees/critique examples earn full credit. Error carry-through is allowed without repeated deduction; critical conceptual failures require remediation under root's common advancement protocol. No conflicting central advancement threshold was introduced.

reviewed.scope_and_distinctness: Read the frozen Form B contract and relevant twelve chapter methods. D1 replaces Form A's smooth interior consumer/convex producer work with perfect-substitute consumer corners, dual targets, a whole conditional-input minimizing set and capacity/opening-fee supply. D2 uses finite inefficient rationing and sole-household production/profit ownership instead of a linear tax ledger and exchange-endowment calculation. D3 uses segmented monopoly with real verification expense and mixed supports rather than Cournot and an observed entry tree. D4 examines a finite signaling assessment, complete off-path belief interval and a restricted informative-audit comparison rather than lemons/screening and an unaudited wage schedule alone. D5 combines public-good financing, a rejection-cascade DA problem and an unequal-arm exact behavioral lottery rather than the Form A externality/second-price/present-bias allocation. The scaffolding includes taught familiar methods, but the reassessment's economic mechanisms and combined constraints differ, not merely its parameters.
reviewed.D1_individual_choice_duality_production: Both consumer optima are globally proved by budget inequalities, with the old bundle's changed-price infeasibility checked. Expenditure targets and all tie minimizers are explicit; CV and EV use the named positive-loss conventions and matching Hicksian bundles. Conditional production cost uses a global linear inequality, identifies a corner and a whole tie segment, and does not rely on an interior tangency. Shutdown compares the capacity endpoint with zero, retaining the disconnected supply tie and the common unavoidable bill. Every outcome and exact unit is supplied in the solutions.
reviewed.D2_equilibrium_rationing_ownership: The competitive finite market has strict participation at the supplied price, equal quantities and an exhaustive ordered-gains argument. The ceiling fixes price, prohibits resale and specifies the actual rationed buyers; CS/PS and total resource surplus reconcile. The loss decomposition compares the same supplied units with their best feasible allocation before adding forgone trade. The separate production equilibrium includes household profit ownership, checks the assumed positive numeraire choice, binds the consumer budget and clears both resources. Omitting profit yields a concrete missing-resource amount. The Pareto claim is proved directly for the sole household on its actual feasible interval using strict concavity, with no claim about omitted parties or a general welfare theorem.
reviewed.D3_market_power_and_mixed_strategy: Common-price profit is maximized on both choke-price branches and compared with zero sales. Separate prices are globally optimal within each linear demand; the real verification fee enters both net private profit and resource surplus, yielding a higher-private-profit/lower-total-surplus result at unchanged quantity. The supplied 3-by-2 game's mixture is solved through the other player's indifference conditions, then every pure action is checked. A parameterized off-support payoff gives a necessary-and-sufficient condition for preserving that specified candidate, distinguishes weak ties from required positive support, and supplies a strict deviation when the threshold fails. No unsupported uniqueness claim about all equilibria is made.
reviewed.D4_information_and_contracts: The signal set is explicitly {0,1}; both on-path beliefs, both types' deviations and participation are checked. Pooling's unused-signal belief is constrained by each type and the probability domain, not inferred from Bayes at a zero-probability signal. The expected credential resource cost is separate from wages and productivity. Contracting has exactly two efforts, explicit reservation utility, limited liability, weak implementation/tie behavior and precisely two permitted wage classes. Output-only and report-only optimal costs follow global IC/IR lower bounds attained by displayed feasible schedules; L and no hiring are also compared. The audited contract cannot depend jointly on output, so no missing joint distribution is implicitly assumed. Principal profit, worker utility and their sum identify a rent redistribution plus a real audit loss rather than a joint-surplus improvement.
reviewed.D5_public_goods_matching_behavior: Public-good benefits, domain, costs, refusal point and enforcement are fully supplied; the optimum is proved globally and feasible nonnegative fees satisfy both strict participation constraints. The task is a financing construction, not an unsupported voluntary contribution equilibrium. The DA task supplies all six strict rankings and one-seat capacities; the complete rejection chain and final matching are checked, with a complete no-blocking argument and correct ordinal/cardinal distinction. The seven-person pilot uses exactly three randomized assignments, full observation, no interference and a prespecified binary behavior outcome. The supplied assignment-count table is independently enumerated; unequal arm sizes produce an asymmetric statistic support, and the required inclusive absolute tail is not replaced by doubling a positive tail. The sharp individual null, assignment-effect target, possible mechanism alternatives, volunteer population and stipulated welfare criterion remain distinct. The welfare calculation is explicitly a plug-in contrast under supplied values and real administrative expense, not a known true causal welfare effect.
reviewed.instruction_and_solution_alignment: Every one of20parts was solved against its exact prompt. Definitions, allowed action sets, boundaries, financing/ownership, tie rules, real costs, observation assumptions and units are given where they matter. All needed methods were taught in the linked Volume5 chapters or their established earlier prerequisites; no new theorem or lookup is required. Critique questions give concrete acceptable reasoning and scoring rather than a single unsupported opinion. Solutions preserve every requested alternative or tie and provide complete point allocations.
reviewed.source_use: No new external empirical, legal or historical claim was introduced. Stable analytical methods are reused through all12chapter links and their previously inspected primary sources, including the chapter routes for expenditure/production, competitive and general equilibrium, monopoly/game theory, signaling/contracting, public goods, matching and exact behavioral randomization. The finite tables, scenarios, combinations of constraints and questions are original; no external examination or source problem was copied. No new source proposal file was requested or created.

It has five20-point questions, four5-point parts each, five matching domain solution entries and20explicit scoring allocations. All12chapter method routes are linked. Only the three assigned files were written; no children, shared files, curriculum/status state, commitments, hosting actions or publication changes. This package is an author draft ready for root review, not an accepted volume assessment.

limitations: This is internal author review and reproducible exact checking, not independent human academic certification or evidence of any learner's mastery.
Numeric and finite structural checks supplement mathematical reading; they do not prove every economic assumption or validate a real-world institution.
The wage optimization applies only to the explicitly allowed contract classes; no general joint-signal optimal-contract claim is made.

The behavioral data are synthetic and the welfare values stipulated. Exact randomization inference does not identify a unique psychological mechanism, a universal population effect or the true numerical welfare change.

No visual, mobile or print UI QA was performed; the standing browser restriction was respected.
Root owns final prompt/solution/rubric audit, common advancement/remediation administration, shared structural/offline checks, archive and publication.
